Join each telescope to its observatory on observstation, excluding unmatched telescopes. Group by observatories.lunarstage, treating NULL as its own phase. For each phase, show the phase; the average of each matched station’s average non-NULL telescopes.bandusagepct, excluding stations with no non-NULL usage from that average; the number of distinct matched stations with that phase; and that number divided by the total number of distinct matched stations across all phases. Do not round.
queries:
WITH station_stats AS (
    SELECT
        o.observstation,
        o.lunarstage,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage,
        COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
    FROM telescopes AS t
    JOIN observatories AS o
      ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
),
phase_stats AS (
    SELECT
        lunarstage AS phase,
        AVG(avg_usage) AS avg_station_usage,
        SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count
    FROM station_stats
    GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
    phase,
    avg_station_usage,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_fraction
FROM phase_stats

WITH station_usage AS (
    SELECT
        o.observstation,
        o.lunarstage,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage
    FROM observatories AS o
    JOIN telescopes AS t
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(avg_usage),
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station_usage)
FROM station_usage
GROUP BY lunarstage
